source.title: Disenchantry, Retail 12.1.5 supported, statistics and material tracking
source.author: x_Raven_x

quote: Track session and lifetime totals separately for each character
notes: NEW collector/provenance lead, NOT a measured yield cohort. Official author's current package page (Nov 15 2026 release 1.2.6) says Retail 12.1.5 compatible, tracks disenchant operations by item quality and received materials per-character in session/lifetime views. No publicly posted player SavedVariables, raw event table, independent sample size, source itemLinks/bonuses/actual ilvl, per-material zero-inclusive per-cast histograms, character skill/specialization or build is supplied on that page. No evidence that its quality/material aggregate can be joined reliably per individual operation, and no public CSV export is documented. Do NOT treat user download counts, addon aggregate forecasts or material totals as completed disenchant casts. Candidate next step: independently inspect actual saved-variables schema or obtain consenting player's original 12.1.5 event log; review before assigning study sourceKind. Distinct new Retail capture lane from previously checked PocketCFO/Goblinomics/GatherBuffs/ProspectMate.
lookingFor: Retail 12.1.5 player-original per-item/ilvl/skill disenchant event receipts with exact input and output IDs, all completed operations including zero results, and per-cast quantities

source.title: DisenchantValue v1.2.0 Midnight expansion classification fix
source.author: GildedFool

quote: Fixed iLvl-based expansion fallback that would have misclassified Midnight gear as TWW
notes: NEW independent addon-author bug-fix/source-classification disclosure, not a measured disenchant result. March 2 2026 changelog says The War Within item levels reach 154 and Midnight item levels begin at 120, so item-level-only expansion routing overlaps; author changed fallback to expansion-ID handling (TWW expacID 10, Midnight >=11). It does NOT prove any Miststalker's Wristbands 272246 ilvl305 disenchant event nor whether generic ilvl206 noDE catalog applies to a scaled bonus item; no at-cast itemLink, material output, finished casts or P(hit). No cross-addon causal inference or measured numeric rate admitted. Preserve as caution when seeking actual item bonus/build source in T0026/T0049; proposed schema/tools concerns go to Master, not direct worker edits.
lookingFor: Player-original 272246 Miststalker's Wristbands live ilvl305 disenchant receipt and independently valid expansion/variant classification for Midnight vs TWW overlap
